prompt: A living mid-century gouache travel-poster painting of the Golden Gate Bridge seen from a beach, static locked-off camera, seamless looping animation. The bridge is rust-orange with two tall towers, fine suspension cables and vertical hangers, spanning to a hazy grey-blue headland on the left and a tan-grey rocky cliff on the right. In the foreground deep cobalt and teal surf rolls in with white foam lines onto a sweeping beach of sandy beige scratchy dry-brush strokes, with dark rocks, a driftwood log and tiny figures in coral, navy and mustard. Warm cream sky with fine paper grain fills the upper half. Matte opaque gouache, ragged flaking edges, visible bristle streaks, speckled worn texture. Gentle motion only: waves wash and recede, foam shimmers, seagulls glide across the sky, tiny people wander. Soft hazy daylight, vertical 3:4, perfect loop.
